notes: «قال حدثني الحبيب الأمين» : the epithet before the name is read as the Companion's own epithet, so Awf is one link; the dashed «- أما هو إلى فحبيب وأما هو عندي فأمين -» is a note on the variant reading of that epithet, left out; a reading doubt
«كنا عند النبي» is Awf's own account and the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6)
